summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload under it
details: @onereach/types-contacts-api is advertised as a TypeScript type-definitions package but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip and then invokes the downloaded `bun` binary against a 727 KB payload shipped in the tarball, `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])`). math_init.js is a Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(...){ for(...) MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()); return MmgoCP }` over a large mixed number/string constant array). setup.mjs itself is also identifier-obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-lookup indirection like `YCZJE: function(...){ return...(...) }`) to hide the literal command names, paths, and URLs it uses. A type-definitions package has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime, an obfuscated install script, or a large obfuscated executable at install time; the payload is deliberately scoped to run under Bun so Node-based scanners cannot inspect it. Installing this package causes an installer-side host to execute obfuscated attacker-controlled code under a freshly downloaded runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
